evidence.name: Screen field: How long to delay the X
evidence.userNeed: Know what "How long to delay the X" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: How long to delay the X
sections.description: How long the close button stays hidden (1-30 seconds) when you've set it to appear after a timer; it has no effect otherwise. A short 2-3 seconds nudges users to read the offer first without feeling trapped. Longer delays raise frustration and drop-off, so reserve 10s or more only for a deliberate hard gate.
